o.text: From Classical Persian حافظ (hāfiz), from Arabic حَافِظ (ḥāfiẓ).
From Proto-Turkic *ād- (“sober, to sober up”). Morphologically, the unattested *ay- + -ıl.
Borrowed from Russian патронта́ш (patrontáš), ultimately from German Patrontasche.
